# Interchange fixtures

- `Box.glb`: unmodified Khronos glTF Sample Assets Box, downloaded 2026-10-22 from
  https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/blob/main/Models/Box/glTF-Binary/Box.glb.
  Copyright 2017 Cesium, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International,
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode. Cesium created the complete model.
  Meshcraft uses this independent, publicly authored fixture to test glTF import.
- `legacy-wall.fbx`: unmodified `examples/carcass_08_div_int.fbx` from the pinned
  k3d source baseline `acd84f4c67509e10363c33850501eb8f4fc3ffa7`, generated by
  Octodraw/MeshIo; used as legacy compatibility evidence. The repository source
  inventory identifies the baseline and provenance.

Additional small ASCII/XML/ZIP fixtures are authored explicitly in the tests. Their
expected coordinates/counts are independent of Meshcraft's exporters.
